addressed_to.description: company, or agent: the invoice is in the name of an employee or a director who bought it as the company's agent. Bill an agent's invoice at what the company paid them back, its GST the GST inside that amount (IRAS's tax fraction of the amount reimbursed), and attach the evidence of the repayment (⚠ until attached). Left out, company.

document.description: What the claim rests on: tax_invoice addressed to the company ("Company c/o another" counts); simplified, a simplified tax invoice, which needs no customer name and is claimable while the bill's total including GST is within the sg-gst pack's limit (S$1,000.00 from 23 Oct 2026; before that, the tax agent decides); import_permit naming the company; none, no valid tax invoice, so nothing is claimed. Left out, tax_invoice.

repaid.description: For an agent's invoice: paid, the company paid them back; director_loan, credited to their director's loan account (FR-EQ-02), whose input tax is not claimed until the tax agent decides (⚠). Left out, paid.

supplier_registered.description: Whether the supplier is GST-registered (its GST number is on the document). false: no GST was charged, and none is claimed. Left out, true.

tax_agent.description: The tax agent's decision on lines the rules leave to them: a director's loan, or a simplified tax invoice dated before the pack's limit. Attach their advice. Ignored on other lines.
